description: This deck is a standard abyssin swarm deck.  It's my secondary deck, but has been doing some serious damage.  And yes, I did steal the idea from Ice Breath.  *Please don't rate, this deck sucks.
strategy: Swarm with abyssins.  That's about all there is to it.  Scum and Chall make abyssins free unless your opponent plays the Camp.  Ree-Yees is broken in this deck, because he adds 3 to any destiny of 3 and all your abyssins are destiny 3.  Also, watto w/ watto's chance cube and Lando V or Ree-Yees when you're flipped with Jabba and Bib on table (Doesn't happen too often, but has happened before) goes something like this.  play watto's chance cube, Draw destiny, get a 3, add either 1 or 3 depending on who it is that's adding. Destiny=4or6(even, so chance cube adds 2 destiny).  Add 2 with the Objective. Destiny=6 or 8.  Then with each of your other two destinies add with the objective and maybe Ree-Yees.  you come up with a total destiny somewhere btwn 11 and 24.  All the POTH people are in there to hold the AC.  I gues that's it.
